purpose: Prevent TOPA from confusing a registered feature with an actually available row-level measurement. Each forensic family is classified by byte availability and reproduction path before real classifier training.

availability_classes.PUBLIC_BYTES_READY: Row-level or directly joinable bytes are publicly shipped at the frozen upstream commit and can be hash-pinned now.
availability_classes.PUBLIC_SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION_REQUIRED: The generator/method is public but the full row-level sidecar is not shipped in the frozen release. TOPA must reproduce it and hash its output before use.
availability_classes.PLANNED_NEW_TOPA_MEASUREMENT: No canonical per-row upstream sidecar is available; TOPA must define and preregister its own measurement before extraction.
availability_classes.FUTURE_EXTERNAL_PUBLIC_DATA: Feature family is conceptually useful but requires a later public-data reconstruction not yet frozen.

families.guard: Coordinates are provenance/grouping inputs and are not default model predictors.
Actual observing opportunity is kept separate from candidate count.
Primary-plate assignment is a coverage partition, not a quality label.

families.source: IRSA DSS1-red plate-addressed FITS primary headers
families.guard: TOPA reads primary-header bytes and hashes provenance; DATE-OBS remains group/provenance, not a predictor.

families.reason: Generator is public, but a full 122820-row morphology sidecar is not shipped in the frozen release tree.
families.guard: Extract continuous measurements and failures; do not inherit upstream threshold decisions as labels.
Keep continuous measurements for all measurable rows; hard reject thresholds are not imported as truth.
Plate-edge position is a quality/context measurement, not an artifact verdict.
If SuperCOSMOS is used as a Tier-B label witness in an arm, every SuperCOSMOS feature is removed from predictors in that arm.
Coverage and match are separate. No PTF coverage is not interpreted as no persistent source.
One-plate coverage is undecidable, not negative. If persistence creates labels, persistence features are excluded from predictors.

families.upstream_context: tools/dedup_radius_sweep.py provides aggregate tolerance evidence, not a canonical full per-row duplicate sidecar.
families.guard: Freeze radius/grid/plate-overlap semantics before extraction and never choose duplicate parameters by nuclear-window result.
Area/opportunity denominator must be defined independently of candidate density.
A red/blue comparison is valid only with explicit plate identity and observation-time separation; non-simultaneous absence is not spectral non-detection.

freeze_rule: A family can enter real classifier training only after its reconstruction parameters, input provenance, row-coverage semantics, output hash and missingness behavior have a machine-readable receipt frozen before any nuclear harmonization result is inspected.
priority_sequence: P1: SuperCOSMOS + PTF coverage/match + neighbor-epoch persistence
P1: TOPA per-row duplicate geometry + local-field context
